# Debug

Debug the reported problem.

Follow [debug-root-cause](../debug-root-cause/SKILL.md) strictly. Preserve evidence, keep competing hypotheses, run discriminating tests, and do not call a reset, reinstall, or workaround the root cause without explaining the state it changes.
